# Component licenses

This integration preserves each supplied project's original license files and notices inside its component directory. Review those licenses before redistribution or commercial deployment.

- `components/AnyJev/` — upstream license file preserved in that tree.
- `components/LLM2Jev/` — upstream license file/notices preserved if present in the supplied archive.
- `components/jev-gateway/` — upstream license metadata/files preserved in that tree.
- `fabric/`, top-level `scripts/`, `config/`, and integration documentation are additions in this generated build; no third-party model weights are included.
